loyalty.description: A read endpoint exists on this hub. The x402 gateway runs on another Cloudflare account and does not write settlements here, so paidCount and credits stay at zero until a feed is implemented. This is not a live credits programme.

tool_requests.proof_detail: GET a short-lived challenge, then find a nonce such that sha256(utf8(challenge + nonce)) has N leading zero hex digits. An optional x402 payment field is stored as unverified; this hub cannot settle or verify payments.

tools.title: fr-company
tools.description: French company lookup (SIREN/SIRET/name) from the official open-data Sirene base (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte Etalab). Returns legal name, SIREN, HQ address, NAF code, status, creation date, directors when public.

q.description: Company name, SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits)

tools.title: eu-vat
tools.description: EU VAT number validation against the European Commission VIES service, with normalised output (valid, name, address).

vat.description: VAT number with 2-letter country prefix, e.g. FR40303265045

tools.title: iban
tools.description: IBAN validation (ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum + per-country length), returns normalised IBAN, country and BBAN.

tools.title: markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return clean Markdown (scripts/styles/nav stripped) plus title. Max 2 MB, 15 s timeout, public IPs only.

url.description: http(s) URL of a public page

tools.title: fr-address
tools.description: French address geocoding and normalisation via the official Base Adresse Nationale (api-adresse.data.gouv.fr). Returns normalised label, postcode, city, INSEE code, lat/lon and score.

tools.title: holidays
tools.description: Official public holidays for a country and year (100+ countries, Nager.Date open data), plus whether a given date is a holiday.

tools.title: fx
tools.description: Currency conversion at the official European Central Bank reference rate (via Frankfurter), with rate date. 30+ fiat currencies.

tools.title: web-meta
tools.description: Fetch a public URL and return its metadata: title, meta description, canonical, language, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, favicon, RSS feeds, h1s. Public IPs only.

tools.title: email-check
tools.description: Email address check: RFC syntax, domain MX/A records (deliverability signal, no SMTP probe), disposable-domain and role-account flags.

tools.title: rdap
tools.description: Domain registration data via RDAP (the official WHOIS successor): registrar, creation/expiry/update dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC, age in days.

tools.title: ch-uid
tools.description: Swiss UID / VAT (MWST/TVA/IVA) number validation against the official Swiss Federal Statistical Office UID register (UID-Register, uid-wse). Returns format check (mod-11), register status, legal name, legal form, address, commercial-register and VAT status. Sole-proprietor names are masked.

uid.description: Swiss UID, e.g. CHE-105.829.940 or CHE105829940 MWST

tools.title: ch-uid-batch
tools.description: Batch Swiss UID / VAT number validation (up to 25 numbers per call) against the official Swiss UID register. Same per-record output as /api/ch-uid. The register allows ~20 lookups/min, so a full batch can take up to ~80 s. Sole-proprietor names are masked.

uids.description: Up to 25 Swiss UIDs, comma/space/newline separated (POST may also send a JSON array)

tools.title: dvf-price-m2
tools.description: French property price per m2 around an address from official DVF sales records (DGFiP / Etalab, last 3 years): median, p25/p75, count for apartments and houses within an auto-expanding radius, geocoded via Base Adresse Nationale. Not available for Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte.

surface.description: optional surface in m2 for an estimate

tools.title: bodacc-health
tools.description: French company legal-health check from the official BODACC notices (DILA open data) for a SIREN/SIRET: insolvency proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation), deregistration, sales, accounts filings, last notice dates and a risk summary. Natural persons (sole traders) are masked.

tools.title: x402-compliance
tools.description: x402 V2 compliance tester: probes any paid endpoint without paying and checks the 402 challenge (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, x402Version 2, accepts[] schema, CAIP-2 network, atomic amount, canonical USDC asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, EIP-712 extra, resource, Bazaar extension, CORS) and that free 200s or forged payment headers never unlock the resource. Returns score, verdict and per-check details.

tools.title: a2a-agent-card
tools.description: A2A Agent Card validator and generator (A2A 1.0, detects and flags v0.3 cards): supportedInterfaces, protocolBinding/protocolVersion, capabilities, media-type modes, skills, provider, security schemes/requirements, JWS signature structure. Validate by URL (fetches /.well-known/agent-card.json) or inline JSON; or mode=generate from name, description, endpoint and skills.

skills.description: generate: JSON array or comma-separated skill names

tools.title: mcp-manifest-lint
tools.description: MCP manifest linter: validates an MCP registry server.json (official schema 2025-12-11: reverse-DNS name, 100-char description, pinned versions, packages registryType/transport, remotes, env vars, isSecret, fileSha256, additionalProperties) or a host config (mcpServers/servers: command vs url, args, env, hard-coded secrets). Inline JSON or URL.

tools.title: x402-manifest-from-openapi
tools.description: Turn an OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 spec (JSON or YAML, URL or inline) into a ready-to-mount x402 V2 paywall: per-operation accepts[] (exact, CAIP-2 network, atomic USDC amount, payTo, EIP-712 extra), @x402/core route config, Bazaar discovery input/output schemas, a /.well-known/x402 document and a sample PAYMENT-REQUIRED payload.

tools.title: pubmed-search
tools.description: PubMed / MEDLINE search with full records: PMID, title, authors, journal, year, volume/pages, DOI, PMCID, publication types, MeSH terms and abstract. Accepts PubMed query syntax or a list of PMIDs. No API key needed.

tools.title: x402-listing-check
tools.description: Checks that a host exposes a valid x402 discovery listing (/.well-known/x402, x402.json, x402-listing): JSON, version, https resource URLs, same host, companions (/openapi.json, /llms.txt), and probes up to 10 listed resources for a real 402 challenge with consistent payTo. Never pays.

tools.title: lei-lookup
tools.description: Legal Entity Identifier lookup from the official GLEIF register: by LEI (with ISO 17442 checksum check) or by legal-name search with optional country. Returns legal name, status, legal form, jurisdiction, legal and HQ addresses, registration status/renewal, BIC, direct and ultimate parents.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 filter for name search

tools.title: rss-to-json
tools.description: RSS 2.0 / RSS 1.0 (RDF) / Atom / JSON Feed to clean JSON: feed title, link, language, updated, items with id, title, link, ISO dates, author, text summary, categories and enclosures (podcasts). URL or inline XML, item cap, `since` filter; HTML pages return discovered feed links.

tools.title: eori-validate
tools.description: EORI number validation (customs trader ID) against the official European Commission EOS register, and UK GB numbers against HMRC. Up to 10 numbers per call; returns validity plus name and address when the trader consented to publication.

tools.title: sec-financials
tools.description: US public company financial facts from SEC EDGAR XBRL (by ticker or CIK): revenue, net income, operating income, gross profit, diluted EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, long-term debt, shares outstanding — last 1-5 fiscal years plus latest quarter, with form, filing date and accession; plus recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings. Any raw us-gaap tag also accepted.

tools.title: openfoodfacts-product
tools.description: Food product sheet from a barcode (EAN/UPC/GTIN) via Open Food Facts: name, brand, quantity, Nutri-Score, NOVA, Eco-Score, nutriments per 100 g, ingredients, allergens, traces, labels, categories, countries, packaging, image.

tools.title: arxiv-search
tools.description: arXiv preprint search (plain words or arXiv field syntax ti:, au:, abs:, cat:) or id lookup: title, authors, dates, categories, abstract, DOI, journal ref, abs and PDF links.

tools.title: crossref-doi
tools.description: DOI metadata from Crossref: type, title, container (journal/book), publisher, authors with ORCID and affiliations, dates, volume/issue/pages, ISSN/ISBN, licenses, abstract, subjects, citation counts, funders, and optionally the reference list.

exampleResponse.title: Nanometre-scale thermometry in a living cell

tools.title: gtin-validate
tools.description: GTIN / EAN-8 / EAN-13 / UPC-A / UPC-E / GTIN-14 validation and normalisation (GS1 check digit): type, expected check digit, corrected code, GTIN-14 and EAN-13 forms, GS1 prefix region, book/coupon flags. Up to 100 codes per call.

tools.title: isbn-validate
tools.description: ISBN-10 / ISBN-13 validation and conversion (ISO 2108 check digits): valid flag, expected check digit, corrected value, both forms, GTIN-14, registration group hint.

tools.title: mcp-inspect
tools.description: Remote MCP server inspector (Streamable HTTP): initialize handshake, protocol version, serverInfo, capabilities, session, latency, tools/list with per-tool checks (name pattern, description, inputSchema object, undocumented or missing required params), resources/prompts counts. Read-only: never calls a tool.

tools.title: openapi-lint
tools.description: OpenAPI linter for agent readiness: version, info, servers, operationId presence/uniqueness/LLM-safe names, summaries, parameter schemas and descriptions, path placeholders, success and error responses, JSON examples. Returns an agent-readiness score and actionable issues.

tools.title: sitemap-urls
tools.description: sitemap.xml URL extractor: reads a sitemap or sitemap index (incl. .gz) and up to 10 child sitemaps, returns URLs with lastmod/changefreq/priority, optional substring filter, capped list (up to 5000).

tools.title: tz-convert
tools.description: IANA time zone conversion: an instant (ISO with offset, Z, or Unix) or a local wall time in a source zone converted to up to 20 zones, with UTC offset, abbreviation and DST gap/overlap handling (ambiguous times return both instants).

time.description: ISO date-time or local time; default now

from.description: Source IANA zone for local times, default UTC

tools.title: uuid-v7
tools.description: RFC 9562 UUIDv7 generator (time-sortable, 1-100 per call, optional timestamp) and UUID validator/decoder (version, variant, embedded timestamp for v1/v7).

timestamp.description: ISO date for the time part

tools.title: siren-check
tools.description: French SIREN (9) / SIRET (14) checksum validation (Luhn, La Poste exception), formatting, NIC, and the derived intra-EU VAT number. Up to 100 numbers. Offline: no register call.

tools.title: phone-parse
tools.description: Phone number parsing and validation to E.164 (libphonenumber numbering plans): validity, country, calling code, type (mobile, fixed line, toll-free…), national/international formats, tel: URI. Up to 50 numbers. No carrier lookup, no call.

country.description: Default ISO country for national numbers

tools.title: x402-facilitator-health
tools.description: x402 facilitator health check: calls GET /supported on a facilitator (or on a default list incl. CDP, xpay, x402.org, PayAI), reports alive/auth-required, latency, supported kinds (version, scheme, network), V2 and network support, and flags deprecated URLs.

network.description: CAIP-2 network to check, default eip155:8453

tools.title: json-schema-validate
tools.description: Validate LLM/agent JSON output against a JSON Schema (2020-12 subset) and auto-repair typical errors: code fences, trailing commas, numbers/booleans as strings, wrong enum case, single value instead of array, null optionals, extra or mis-cased keys, missing defaults. Returns errors, repaired JSON and fixes. POST recommended.

data.description: JSON value or string to check

tools.title: wikidata-entity
tools.description: Wikidata entity lookup by Q-id or search text: label, description, aliases in a chosen language, key claims (instance of, country, coordinates, inception, website, population, HQ, founders, industry, identifiers such as LEI/ticker/ISNI…) with resolved labels, Wikipedia link.

tools.title: fr-communes
tools.description: French municipalities (INSEE COG) by name, postcode or INSEE code: official name, INSEE code, postcodes, population, area, department, region, EPCI, SIREN, centre coordinates.

tools.title: fx-history
tools.description: Official ECB reference-rate time series for a currency pair (or up to 10 targets) over a date range up to 2 years: daily points plus first/last/min/max/mean/% change.

tools.title: fr-school-calendar
tools.description: French school holidays (calendrier scolaire, Éducation nationale) by school year and zone A/B/C (or overseas/Corsica), with académies, start/end dates, and an optional date test (is this date a school holiday, and where).

zone.description: A, B, C or overseas zone

tools.title: openapi-to-mcp
tools.description: Convert an OpenAPI spec (JSON/YAML, URL or inline) into MCP tool definitions: LLM-safe unique names, descriptions, JSON Schema inputSchema (query/path/header params + JSON body), MCP annotations (readOnly/destructive/idempotent), plus HTTP forwarding hints and a ready tools/list response.

tools.title: sanctions-check
tools.description: Sanctions screening of a person, company or vessel name against the US Consolidated Screening List (OFAC SDN with aliases plus other Treasury, Commerce BIS and State lists), the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (FSF), the French national asset-freeze register (DG Trésor) and the UK sanctions list (FCDO). Fuzzy Jaro-Winkler token matching with score, programmes, DOB; lists refreshed daily.

tools.title: fr-legal-status
tools.description: French company legal status by SIREN/SIRET: Sirene administrative status (active/ceased, closure date, legal form, NAF, head office) plus BODACC collective proceedings (sauvegarde, redressement, liquidation judiciaire, clôture) with latest stage, ongoing flag and risk level.

tools.title: eu-tenders
tools.description: Public tender scanner: keyword search across BOAMP (France) and TED (EU Official Journal, all member states) since a date, merged and sorted: title, buyer, publication date, deadline, notice type, country, CPV codes and link.

country.description: TED buyer country ISO alpha-3, e.g. DEU

tools.title: uk-postcode
tools.description: UK postcode lookup and validation (postcodes.io, ONS/OS open data): country, region, district, ward, parish, constituency, lat/lon, eastings/northings, NUTS; terminated postcodes detected; reverse lookup from lat/lon.

tools.title: eu-address
tools.description: Address geocoding and normalisation through official national open services: France (Base Adresse Nationale), Netherlands (PDOK/BAG), Spain (CartoCiudad/IGN), Switzerland (swisstopo). Returns normalised label, street, number, postcode, city, region, coordinates and score.

tools.title: no-company
tools.description: Norwegian company register (Brønnøysundregistrene) by org number or name: legal form, registration and founding dates, VAT registration and VAT number, bankruptcy, liquidation and forced-dissolution flags, employees, industry, address, website.

tools.title: fi-company
tools.description: Finnish company register (PRH / YTJ open data) by Business ID (Y-tunnus) or name: current name, registration date, legal form, status, trade-register status, main business line, address, website, EUID and derived VAT number.

tools.title: uk-company
tools.description: UK company register (official Companies House API): search by name, or lookup by company number with profile (status, type, incorporation/dissolution, SIC codes, registered office, previous names), officer counts (active/resigned) and filing status (accounts and confirmation statement due/overdue), insolvency, liquidation and charges flags.

tools.title: kyb-check-uk
tools.description: One-call KYB for a UK company (company number or name): Companies House profile, officers and filing status, insolvency/liquidation flags, plus sanctions screening (US CSL/OFAC, EU, FR, UK) of the registered name, with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.

tools.title: eu-carbon-customs
tools.description: EU CBAM (carbon border adjustment) default embedded emissions for a CN/TARIC code and country of origin, from the official Commission default-values file: direct, indirect and total tCO2e per tonne, production route, year mark-up, and optional embedded emissions and certificate cost for a shipment (tonnes, EUR price).

country.description: Origin country name or ISO alpha-2

tools.title: kyb-check-eu
tools.description: One-call KYB for any EU company by VAT number: VIES validity with registered name/address, sanctions screening (US CSL/OFAC, EU, FR, UK) of the name, GLEIF LEI candidates, plus national register data for France (Sirene + BODACC proceedings) and Finland (PRH), with a pass/review/fail verdict.

vat.description: EU VAT number with country prefix

name.description: Company name if VIES does not publish it

tools.title: kyb-check-fr
tools.description: One-call KYB for a French company (SIREN/SIRET): Sirene identity and status, BODACC collective proceedings, VIES intra-EU VAT validity (derived FR number) and sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, FR, UK) of the legal name, with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.

tools.title: supplier-due-diligence
tools.description: Supplier due diligence for any company name (optionally VAT number and country): VIES VAT check, UK Companies House profile when country=GB, GLEIF LEI candidates with entity and registration status, and sanctions screening (OFAC, EU, FR, UK), with a pass/review/fail verdict and flags.

actors.title: Swiss UID / VAT validator
actors.description: Bulk Swiss UID/VAT (MWST/TVA/IVA) validation and company lookup against the official federal UID register. Detects VAT groups, checks the check digit offline, and redacts sole-proprietor names by default.
actors.source: Swiss Federal Statistical Office UID-Register (uid-wse), official, no auth, about 20 lookups/min.

pricing.notes: Invalid numbers that fail the check digit are charged as format-check only. Errors are free.

actors.title: DVF price per m² (batch)
actors.description: For a list of French addresses or coordinates, returns median, P25 and P75 €/m² from official DVF sales (apartments and houses separately), with an optional value range for a given surface. Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte are flagged and not charged.
actors.source: geo-dvf CSVs on files.data.gouv.fr (Etalab, Licence Ouverte 2.0) and the Base Adresse Nationale geocoder.

actors.title: BODACC SIREN health check
actors.description: Batch check of SIREN/SIRET/FR-VAT numbers against official BODACC notices: insolvency stage and history, strike-off, late accounts, business sales, and an explained risk level. Sole traders are masked by default.
actors.source: BODACC open-data API (DILA, Opendatasoft, Licence Ouverte 2.0), no key required.

pricing.notes: Invalid input and errors are free.

actors.title: Google Sheets sync (service account)
actors.description: Import, export, append and upsert Google Sheets rows with a service account (no OAuth expiry). The buyer provides their own key. Cell values default to RAW to reduce formula injection risk.
actors.source: Google Sheets API v4, authenticated with the buyer's service account.

pricing.notes: Charged per 1,000 rows processed. The buyer must share the sheet with the service account.
